description: Create an autonomous AI agent on the user's Fine Structure account: a standing worker, not a chat session. It gets the platform's default safe tool policy and its own email address, it can read and write the app database, and once the owner phone is verified (see get_agent_whatsapp) it can message its owner on WhatsApp and by email through the platform system channels. Pair it with schedule_agent_task for recurring work such as following up new leads on WhatsApp each morning, watching an app for runtime errors, or sending a weekly summary. Messaging anyone other than the verified owner requires a channel the owner connects in the Fine Structure Studio.

app_id.description: Optional app to attach the agent to; account-level when omitted

description.description: What this agent is responsible for, one or two sentences

name.description: Agent display name (e.g. 'Lead Follow-up'). Auto-derived from role when omitted.

persona.description: Optional working style and tone instructions for the agent

name: create_agent
title: Create Agent
